critical_code_review_comments: follows.py uses asyncio.get_event_loop().create_task at import time — works with current FastAPI lifespan but is fragile in Python 3.12+. Consider moving _ensure_indexes() into an @app.on_event('startup') hook for portability.

GET /follows/{user_id}/stats returns 200 with zero counts for unknown user_id (no existence check) — current contract is permissive (matches public-eCard usage) so this is by design; flag as minor in case 404 semantics are preferred later.
Network suggestion query relies on provider's category_id; if a provider has no category set, suggestions silently return []. UX-wise the MiRedPage already renders an empty-state, so acceptable.

_enrich_user does one users.find_one + one provider_profiles.find_one per row in /me/following and /me/followers — O(N) queries. Fine at small scale (capped at 500) but switch to a single $lookup or batched find for scaling >100 follows per user.
